Sir,

Presumbaly the "special pass" mentioned in the
attached letter from Mr. H.C. Young, Chairman of the Shanghai
Cereals Dealers' United Office, is intended to mean a pass
that will permit its holder to enter or pass through a
barricaded area. However, the S.M.C. does not issue such
passes.

The Supervisory and Direction Office of the S.M.C.
Pao Chia Administration will shortly be issuing special
citizenship passes to Chinese only. Persons requiring such
passes should apply to the Pao Chia Office.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER 30 MAY 42）

TRANSLATION

Regulations governing the issuing of
Special Citizenship Certificate

Article 1 Apart from the issuing of ordinary Citizenship
Certificates, Special Citizenship Certificates will be
issued to specific persons with a view to securing the
utmost efforts in maintaining peace and order in the
Settlement and promoting Sino-Japanese rapprochement for
the realization of co-prosperity and co-existence of
the two nations.

Article 2 In principle, Special Citizenship Certificates will
be issued directly by the Commissioner of the Shanghai
Municipal Police.

Article 3 Officers-in-charge of Stations will be responsible
for the enquiries and recommendations for the issuing
of Special Citizenship Certificates to specific persons.

Article 4 The specific persons mentioned in the proceeding
paragraphs are:-
A) Military and Naval officers, and those who have
contributed towards Sino-Japanese peace.
B) Persons of high social and moral standing, and
those who have contributed towards public and
social welfare thereby promoting Sino-Japanese
peace.
C) Persons recommended by high Military and Naval
officials.
D) High officials of the S.M.C. and persons specified
by the Police Force.
E) Those who have done special good work for the
Pao Chia System in the Settlement.

Article 5 The procedures of issue will be as follows:-
Special Citizenship Certificates will be issued
after due consideration by the Headquarters of the
S.M.P. on the recommendation of the Officers-in-charge
of Stations after investigation.

Article 6 Holders of Special Citizenship Certificates
will be accorded the following preferential treatments:-
A) They will be allowed passage during time of
extraordinary precautions.
B) They will be exempt from interrogation and
bodily search in the front of the public.

Article 7 The preferential treatment of persons holding
Special Citizenship Certificates will be referred to
the military and other official authorities by the
S.M.C. for observance.

Article 8 A specimen of the Special Citizenship Certificate
is attached hereto.

译文

特别市民证签发条例

第一条 除签发普通市民证外，为确保持续努力维护租界和平与秩序，促进中日亲善，以实现两国共荣共存，将向特定人员签发特别市民证。

第二条 原则上，特别市民证由上海公共租界工部局警务处总监直接签发。

第三条 各巡捕房主管官员负责对向特定人员签发特别市民证进行调查并提出建议。

第四条 前文所述之特定人员如下：
A) 陆海军军官，以及为中日和平做出贡献者。
B) 社会地位崇高、道德高尚者，以及通过促进公共和社会福利从而推动中日和平者。
C) 由陆海军高级官员推荐者。
D) 上海公共租界工部局高级官员及警队指定人员。
E) 在租界内为保甲制度做出特殊贡献者。

第五条 签发程序如下：
特别市民证经各巡捕房主管官员调查并提出建议后，由上海公共租界工部局警务处总部审慎考虑后签发。

第六条 特别市民证持有人将获得以下优待：
A) 在实施特别警戒期间，允许其通行。
B) 免除在公众面前的盘问和搜身。

第七条 上海公共租界工部局将把特别市民证持有人的优待事宜转介给军方及其他官方机构，以供遵守。

第八条 特别市民证样本附后。

- 完 -

( TRANSLATION )

REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE ISSUE OF CITIZENSHIP
CERTIFICATES IN THE INTERNATIONAL SETTLEMENT
OF SHANGHAI

Chapter I. General Rules

Article 1. All citizens in the International Settlement
of Shanghai who have fixed abodes and who pay
municipal rates to the S.M.C. and their family
members above 7 years of age (full age) must apply
for citizenship certificates.

Article 2. Citizenship certificates are issued by the
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Article 3. A Citizenship Certificate Issuing Office is
established by the Shanghai Municipal Police to
manage affairs regarding the issue of such
certificates.

Article 4. Enquiries relating to the issue of citizenship
certificates are undertaken by the Pao Chia Section
of the various Police Stations which also assist in
the issuing of the certificates.

Article 5. A citizenship certificate is issued according
to the following forms :-
(a) Form No.1 Application form for the issue of
citizenship certificate of the
International Settlement of
Shanghai.
(b) Form No.2 Citizenship certificate.
(c) Form No.3 Specified type and size of photo.

Article 6. To facilitate the distinguishing of the
residents of Divisions "A", "B", "C" and "D",
horizontal lines of the following different colours
are printed on the citizenship certificates and
its application form :-
(a) Division "A" Red horizontal line.
(b) Division "B" Green horizontal line.
(c) Division "C" Yellow horizontal line.
(d) Division "D" Blue horizontal line.

Article 7. A citizen must apply for a citizenship
certificate on his or her own behalf.

Chapter II. Principal rules regarding
the issue of citizenship
certificates

Article 8. In making an application for issue of a
citizenship certificate by a citizen, the guarantee
of the Chief of Wu and the Chief of Chia concerned
is required.

上海公共租界市民证签发条例

第一章 总则

第一条 上海公共租界内所有拥有固定住所并向上海公共租界工部局缴纳市政捐税的市民及其年满7岁（足岁）以上的家庭成员，必须申请市民证。

第二条 市民证由上海公共租界工部局警务处签发。

第三条 上海公共租界工部局警务处设立市民证签发办公室，以管理有关此类证件签发的事务。

第四条 有关市民证签发的查询工作由各巡捕房保甲股承担，该股亦协助签发证件。

第五条 市民证按下列格式签发：
(a) 表格第1号 上海公共租界市民证签发申请表。
(b) 表格第2号 市民证。
(c) 表格第3号 规定类型和尺寸的照片。

第六条 为便于区分“A”、“B”、“C”和“D”区的居民，市民证及其申请表上印有不同颜色的横线：
(a) “A”区 红色横线。
(b) “B”区 绿色横线。
(c) “C”区 黄色横线。
(d) “D”区 蓝色横线。

第七条 市民必须亲自申请市民证。

第二章 市民证签发的主要规则

第八条 市民申请签发市民证时，须由所属伍长和甲长担保。

Article 9. The procedure in applying for citizenship
certificate is as follows :-
(a) The applicant is required to fill in the
application form all details required according to
the Remarks printed on the reverse side of the
form, which, after having been chopped by the
applicant, is to be forwarded to the Chief of Wu.
(b) Having secured the guarantee of the 'Chief of'
Chia and the Chief of Wu, the applicant should
forward his or her application form, together with
2 photos of the specified size and type, to the
Pao Chia Section of the Police Station concerned.
(c) The applicant is required to call at the Police
Station concerned and receive his or her citizenship
certificate three days after the forwarding of his
or her application form.

Article 10. The following are the responsibilities and
duties of the Chief of Wu :-
(a) The Chief of Wu is under an obligation to instruct all
residents above the age of 7 years living in his
house to carry their citizenship certificates.
(b) The Chief of Wu is not allowed to guarantee
residents other than those living in his house.
(c) The Chief of Wu must not guarantee any
resident in his house whose character he thinks is
improper.
(d) The Chief of Wu should collect all application
forms in his house and forward them to the Chief of
Chia for the latter's signature and chop as
additional guarantee.
(e) Having secured the guarantee of the Chief of
Chia, the Chief of Wu should immediately return the
application forms to the applicants concerned.

Article 11. The duties and responsibilities of the Chief
of Chia are as follows :-
1. The Chief of Chia is not allowed to act as
guarantor for residents not belonging to his own
Chia.
2. The Chief of Chia should not guarantee any
applicant whom he considers undesirable.
3. The Chief of Chia, after having signed and
sealed the application as guarantor, should
immediately return the application to the Chief of
Wu.

Article 12. The Chief of Pao will be responsible for the
supervision of all affairs within his Pao, although
he is not directly responsible for the issue of
citizenship certificates.

Article 13. General principles relating to the procedure
of issuing citizenship certificates are included in
the detailed rules governing the procedure of
issuing citizenship certificates.

Article 14. Citizenship certificates must always be
carried on the person.

第九条 申请市民证的程序如下：
(a) 申请人须按照表格背面印有的备注填写所需全部详情，经申请人盖章后，送交伍长。
(b) 获得甲长和伍长的担保后，申请人应将申请表连同两张规定尺寸和类型的照片，送交所属巡捕房的保甲股。
(c) 申请人须在递交申请表三天后，前往所属巡捕房领取市民证。

第十条 伍长的职责和义务如下：
(a) 伍长有义务指示其户内所有年满7岁以上的居民携带市民证。
(b) 伍长不得为其户内居民以外的居民提供担保。
(c) 伍长不得为其认为品行不端的户内任何居民提供担保。
(d) 伍长应收集其户内所有申请表，并送交甲长签字盖章，作为附加担保。
(e) 获得甲长担保后，伍长应立即将申请表退还给相关申请人。

第十一条 甲长的职责和义务如下：
1. 甲长不得为其所属甲以外的居民担任担保人。
2. 甲长不得为其认为不良的任何申请人提供担保。
3. 甲长在作为担保人在申请表上签字盖章后，应立即将申请表退还给伍长。

第十二条 保长负责监督其保内的一切事务，尽管他不直接负责市民证的签发。

第十三条 有关市民证签发程序的一般原则包含在市民证签发程序细则中。

第十四条 市民证必须随身携带。

(a) 伍长有义务指示其户内所有七岁以上之居民携带市民证。
(b) 伍长不得为其户内以外之居民提供担保。
(c) 伍长不得为其认为品行不端之任何户内居民提供担保。
(d) 伍长应收集其户内所有申请表，并送交甲长签署及盖章，以作附加担保。
(e) 取得甲长担保后，伍长应立即将申请表退还给有关申请人。

第十一条. 甲长之职责与义务如下：
1. 甲长不得为其所属甲以外之居民充当担保人。
2. 甲长不得为其认为不良之任何申请人提供担保。
3. 甲长作为担保人签署并盖印申请表后，应立即将申请表退还给伍长。

第十二条. 保长虽不直接负责签发市民证，但须负责监督其保内之一切事务。

第十三条. 关于签发市民证程序之一般原则，包含在管辖签发市民证程序之细则中。

第十四条. 市民证必须随时随身携带。

- 3 -

Article 15. Citizenship certificates are not allowed to
be loaned to others.

Article 16. In case of loss, the person concerned should
report personally to the Police Station responsible
for the issue of the certificate.

Article 17. In case of removal or death, the citizenship
certificate should be handed to the Police Station
concerned together with the removal report or death
report etc. Persons reaching the age of 7 years,
or persons removing into the Settlement with the
intention of living a long period therein, should
apply for citizenship certificates.

Article 18. Persons contravening the following conditions
will be punished:-
1) Making counterfeit citizenship certificates or
participating/or possessing or selling of same.
2) Obtaining citizenship certificates by means of
fraud or threats.
3) Illegal use of another's certificates or
privately transferring same.
4) Issuing certificates privately by persons
concerned through bribery or out of friendship.

- end -
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

第十五条. 市民证不得借予他人。

第十六条. 如有遗失，当事人应亲自向负责签发该证之警察分局报告。

第十七条. 如遇迁出或死亡，市民证应连同迁出报告或死亡报告等一并缴交有关警察分局。年满七岁之人，或迁入租界并拟长期居住之人，应申请市民证。

第十八条. 违反下列条件者将受处罚：
1) 伪造市民证，或参与、持有或出售伪造之市民证。
2) 以欺诈或威胁手段获取市民证。
3) 非法使用他人证件或私自转让证件。
4) 有关人员通过贿赂或出于私情私自签发证件。

PROVISIONAL REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE INSTITUTION OF THE
PAO CHIA SYSTEM, THE TAKING OF A CENSUS AND THE ISSUING
OF CITIZENSHIP CERTIFICATES BY THE SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
POLICE.

CHAPTER I. - GENERAL RULES

Article 1. - For the purpose of taking a census and
eliminating acts of terrorism and maintaining
peace and order, the Shanghai Municipal
Police promulgates these PROVISIONAL
REGULATIONS governing the institution of
the PAO CHIA SYSTEM, the taking of a census
and the issuing of CITIZENSHIP CERTIFICATES
which will be conducted under the direction
of the Police.

Article 2. - All citizens of the Republic of China living
in the International Settlement must comply
with the PAO CHIA SYSTEM.

Article 3. - The PAO CHIA DISTRICTS will be divided
according to Police Districts.

"A" Division
Central Pao Chia District
Louza Pao Chia District
Chengtu Road Pao Chia District

"B" Division
Sinsa Pao Chia District
Bubbling Well Pao Chia District
Gordon Road Pao Chia District
Pootoo Road Pao Chia District

"C" Division
Hongkew Pao Chia District
West Hongkew Pao Chia District
Kashing Road Pao Chia District
Dixwell Road Pao Chia District

"D" Division
Wayside Pao Chia District
Yulin Road Pao Chia District
Yangtsepoo Pao Chia District

Article 4. - A PAO CHIA PREPARATORY COMMITTEE of 10 to
15 members of the area concerned will be
formed in each Police District. Each
Committee will proceed to form Pao Chia
Districts according to Police Districts.
There will be one Chief and two Deputy-
Chiefs for each District.
A Pao Chia District will be divided into
Sections according to Police Sections.
There will be one Chief and two Deputy-
Chiefs for each Section.

上海公共租界工部局警务处实施保甲制度、进行人口普查及签发市民证之暂行条例。

第一章. - 总则

第一条. - 为进行人口普查、肃清恐怖活动及维持治安秩序起见，上海公共租界工部局警务处颁布本暂行条例，以规范在警务处指导下实施保甲制度、进行人口普查及签发市民证之事宜。

第二条. - 所有居住在公共租界内之中华民国公民，必须遵守保甲制度。

第三条. - 保甲区将按照警察分区划分。

“A” 分区
中央保甲区
老闸保甲区
成都路保甲区

“B” 分区
新闸保甲区
静安寺保甲区
戈登路保甲区
普陀路保甲区

“C” 分区
虹口保甲区
西虹口保甲区
嘉善路保甲区
狄思威路保甲区

“D” 分区
韦尔斯利保甲区 (音译)
榆林路保甲区
杨树浦保甲区

第四条. - 每个警察分区将成立一个由该地区10至15名成员组成的保甲筹备委员会。各委员会将按照警察分区组建保甲区。每区设区长一人，副区长二人。
保甲区将按照警察分段划分为若干段。每段设段长一人，副段长二人。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

A Pao Chia Section will be divided into
Pao, Chia and Hu according to Article 5.

Following the completion of the preparations
by the PAO CHIA PREPARATORY COMMITTEE, this
Committee will be dissolved. A new Committee
to be known as the "PAO CHIA COMMITTEE" will
be formed by the Shanghai Municipal Council
to attend to all affairs.

Article 5. - The formation of Hu, Chia and Pao will be
according to the following plan :-

(a) HU - Each shop and dwelling house will be
known as HU with one Chief.
(b) CHIA - Ten HU will form one CHIA with one
Chief.
(c) PAO - Ten CHIA will form one PAO with one
Chief.
(d) Buildings, such as apartments, hotels,
factories, etc. accommodating large
numbers of persons may be considered as
one or more CHIA in which they must form
their own HU and CHIA.
(e) Under special circumstances, the rule
of Paragraph (a) governing the formation
of CHIA may be adjusted by increasing the
number of HU in a CHIA to 15 or by
decreasing the number to 6.

Article 6. - Every Chief of Hu will be responsible for
the correct filling in of the census forms
distributed by the Police.

Article 7. - (a) PAO CHIA CERTIFICATE - Upon completion
of the census, a PAO CHIA CERTIFICATE
will be issued to a Hu and shall be
affixed in a conspicuous position to
the main outside entrance to the premises,
and remain at all times legible and
undefaced.
(b) CITIZENSHIP CERTIFICATE - Occupants of a
Hu are required to be in possession of
CITIZENSHIP CERTIFICATE issued by the
Police on application and such certificates
should always be carried on the person.
(Conditions governing this certificate
will be issued separately).

CHAPTER II. - REGULATIONS RELATING TO THE
APPOINTMENT OF CHIEFS OF HU, CHIA,
PAO SECTIONS AND DISTRICTS

Article 8. - (a) Chief of Hu - The chief tenant should be
appointed as the Chief of Hu, except in
the case of Article 9, in which event, a
responsible sub-tenant should be appointed
as the Chief. If there be no person
qualified on the premises to become the
Chief, the Chia concerned will detail a
person to act as Chief of Hu.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

保甲段将按照第五条之规定划分为保、甲及户。

保甲筹备委员会完成准备工作后，该委员会即行解散。上海公共租界工部局将组建一个新的委员会，称为“保甲委员会”，以处理一切事务。

第五条. - 户、甲及保之组建将按照下列计划进行：

(a) 户 - 每一店铺及住宅称为一户，设户长一人。
(b) 甲 - 十户组成一甲，设甲长一人。
(c) 保 - 十甲组成一保，设保长一人。
(d) 公寓、旅馆、工厂等容纳大量人员之建筑物，可视为一个或多个甲，其中必须自行组建户及甲。
(e) 在特殊情况下，可调整关于组建甲之(a)款规定，将一甲内之户数增加至15户，或减少至6户。

第六条. - 每户长须负责正确填写由警务处分发之人口普查表格。

第七条. - (a) 保甲证 - 人口普查完成后，将向每户签发保甲证，并须张贴于该处所主要外部入口之显眼位置，且须始终保持清晰可辨，不得涂改。
(b) 市民证 - 住户须持有经申请由警务处签发之市民证，且该证件须随时随身携带。（有关该证件之条件将另行发布）。

第二章. - 关于任命户、甲、保、段及区各级长之规章

第八条. - (a) 户长 - 除第九条规定之情况外，应任命主要承租人为户长；在此情况下，应任命一名负责任之分承租人为户长。若该处所无合格人选担任户长，则由有关甲指派一人代理户长。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

(b) Chief of Chia - The Chief of Chia should
be appointed from amongst the Chiefs of
Wu or recommended by the Chief of Pao.

(c) Chief of Pao - The Chief of Pao should be
appointed from amongst the Chiefs of
Chia or recommended by the Chief of
Section.

(d) Chief of Section - The Chief of Section
should be appointed from amongst the
Chiefs of Pao or recommended by Chief
of District.

(e) Chief of District - The Chief of District
should be appointed from amongst the
Chiefs of Sections or recommended by the
Police.

Article 9. - The following are not qualified to act as
officials of the PAO CHIA organization :-

(a) Females.
(b) Persons who are under the age of 20.
(c) Illiterates.
(d) Persons who have no proper profession or
occupation.
(e) Persons who have been deprived of their
civil rights.
(f) Persons who have connection with
subversive movements which are detrimental
to peace and order.
(g) Persons who have serious physical defects.

Article 10. - As soon as the election of Chiefs of
Districts, Sections, Pao, Chia and Wu is
completed, a list of their names and
qualifications should be immediately sent
to the Police after which certificates of
appointment will be issued.

CHAPTER III. - THE DUTIES OF CHIEFS OF DISTRICTS,
SECTIONS, PAO, CHIA AND WU.

Article 11. - The following will constitute the functions
of the PAO CHIA organizations:-

(a) To register residents, changes of address
as well as births and deaths.
(b) To investigate and report the activities
or the presence of undesirable elements
in the district.
(c) To render assistance to the Police in
effecting the arrest of terroristic and
other undesirable elements.
(d) To observe the movements of residents in
the district.
(e) To report to the proper authorities the
transportation or storage of hazardous
materials.
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

(b) 甲长 - 应从伍长中任命甲长，或由保长推荐。

(c) 保长 - 应从甲长中任命保长，或由段长推荐。

(d) 段长 - 应从保长中任命段长，或由区长推荐。

(e) 区长 - 应从段长中任命区长，或由警务处推荐。

第九条. - 下列人员不具备担任保甲组织官员之资格：

(a) 女性。
(b) 未满二十岁之人。
(c) 文盲。
(d) 无正当职业或生计之人。
(e) 被剥夺公民权之人。
(f) 与危害治安秩序之颠覆运动有关联之人。
(g) 患有严重身体缺陷之人。

第十条. - 一旦完成区、段、保、甲及伍各级长之选举，应立即将其姓名及资历名单送交警务处，随后将签发委任状。

第三章. - 区、段、保、甲及伍各级长之职责。

第十一条. - 保甲组织之职能如下：

(a) 登记居民、地址变更以及出生和死亡。
(b) 调查并报告区内不良分子之活动或存在。
(c) 协助警务处逮捕恐怖分子及其他不良分子。
(d) 监视区内居民之动向。
(e) 向有关当局报告危险物品之运输或储存情况。

page_data.en:
- 4 -

(f) To assist in maintaining peace and
order in the district by organizing
VIGILANCE CORPS, regulations of
which will be issued separately.

Article 12. - The duties of Chief of District are to
supervise the workings of the whole Pao
Chia organization in his District.
The duties of a Deputy-Chief are to
assist the Chief or to act in his absence.

Article 13. - The duties of Chief of Section are to
assist the Chief of the District and to
supervise the proper working of the Chiefs
of Pao in his Section.
The duties of a Deputy-Chief are to assist
the Chief or to act in his absence.

Article 14. - The duties of Chief of Pao are to assist
the Chief of Section in the execution of
his work and to supervise the proper
working of the Chiefs of Chia in his Pao.

Article 15. - The duties of Chief of Chia are to assist
the Chief of Pao in the execution of his
duties and to supervise the proper working
of the Chiefs of Hu.

Article 16. - The Chief of Hu should attend to the
proper filling up of census forms and to
report immediately all changes of
addresses as well as births and deaths.

Article 17. - In the event of a person who had signed a
mutual guarantee bond becoming involved in
unlawful activities, the others who had
signed the same bond will also be held
responsible.

Article 18. - In connection with the promotion of Pao
Chia work in the various districts, the
Police Stations concerned will from time
to time despatch officers to undertake
supervision work.

CHAPTER IV - REWARD AND PUNISHMENT.

Article 19. - Punishment in accordance with law will be
imposed on persons who commit any of the
following offences and who may be denied
sanctuary of the Settlement in serious
cases :-

(a) Aiding, abetting or conspiring with or
giving shelter to undesirable elements
or intentionally withholding
information concerning activities or
presence of undesirable elements.
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

(f) 通过组织义勇队协助维持区内治安秩序，其规章将另行发布。

第十二条. - 区长之职责为监督其区内整个保甲组织之运作。
副区长之职责为协助区长或在区长缺席时代理其职。

第十三条. - 段长之职责为协助区长，并监督其段内各保长之正常运作。
副段长之职责为协助段长或在段长缺席时代理其职。

第十四条. - 保长之职责为协助段长执行工作，并监督其保内各甲长之正常运作。

第十五条. - 甲长之职责为协助保长执行职务，并监督各户长之正常运作。

第十六条. - 户长应负责正确填写人口普查表格，并立即报告所有地址变更以及出生和死亡情况。

第十七条. - 若签署联保具结书之人卷入非法活动，其他签署同一具结书之人亦须承担责任。

第十八条. - 为推动各区保甲工作，有关警察分局将不时派遣警官进行监督工作。

第四章 - 奖惩。

第十九条. - 犯有下列任何罪行之人，将依法惩处，情节严重者可能被拒绝在租界内居留：

(a) 协助、教唆、勾结或窝藏不良分子，或故意隐瞒有关不良分子活动或存在之信息。

page_data.en:
- 5 -

(b) Violating of Pao Chia regulations or
refusing to fill in census forms or
giving inaccurate information in the
census.
(c) Neglecting duties allotted to them.
(d) Unnecessarily exercising of authority
or committing corrupt practices.
(e) Disturbing the peace and order.
(f) Promoting any people's movement without
permission.

Article 20. - Rewards will be issued to persons for
performing any of the following acts :-

(a) Giving information about undesirable
elements or immediately reporting the
presence of such, thereby leading to
their arrest.
(b) Giving information regarding firearms
and ammunition or subversive literature.
(c) Working diligently for the maintenance
of peace and order in the district.
(d) Rendering meritorious service in Pao
Chia affairs.

Relatives or dependents of persons
encountering death or sustaining injuries in the
execution of their duties will receive compassionate
grants.

Article 21. - These regulations are subject to amendment.
page_data.zh:
- 5 -

(b) 违反保甲条例，或拒绝填写户口调查表，或在户口调查中提供不实信息。
(c) 玩忽指派之职责。
(d) 滥用职权或营私舞弊。
(e) 扰乱治安与秩序。
(f) 未经许可鼓动任何民众运动。

第二十条。凡有下列行为之一者，予以奖励：

(a) 提供关于不良分子的情报，或立即报告此类人员之出现，从而促成其被捕。
(b) 提供关于枪支弹药或颠覆性文献的情报。
(c) 为维持本区治安与秩序而勤勉工作。
(d) 在保甲事务中作出有功绩的服务。

因执行公务而死亡或受伤者之亲属或受扶养人，将获得抚恤金。

第二十一条。本条例得予修订。
